issues.issue: Whether the Appellant could have left China on his own documents without a smuggler
issues.applicant_position: RPD erred in finding he could exit on his own passport if wanted; RPD did not ask about smuggler support at customs.
issues.result_text: No probative evidence he was wanted; he could leave China with appropriate documents; smuggler use not believed.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellant is wanted by the PSB, given the summons
issues.applicant_position: RPD reasoned backwards; the summons shows no sign of inauthenticity and should not be given no weight.
issues.result_text: Given fraudulent documentation, the Appellant was not wanted by Chinese authorities as alleged.

issues.issue: Whether the corroborative documents and protest involvement establish persecution
issues.applicant_position: Deeply involved as a volunteer; the BOC narrative sets out protest involvement; RPD ignored relevant evidence.
issues.result_text: Appellant's name is absent from the expropriation document; no probative evidence of protest or incarceration.

issues.issue: Whether the Appellant's religious affiliation creates a risk on return to China
issues.applicant_position: Religious identity and practice are sufficiently shown; RPD erred saying he could choose any church; restrictions are serious.
issues.result_text: RAD finds the Appellant could return to China without fear; his wife practises Catholicism there without persecution.
